observations: Google Images results emphasize salutes, flags, servicemembers, poppies, appreciation messages and community remembrance. No copied pixels or layouts.

The collection will emphasize independent living people, school visits, skills, accessible community scenes, symbolic objects and original crafts. Avoid a shared generic soldier base or unearned official decorations.
Veterans Day honors service, including living veterans, and is distinct from Memorial Day. Public metadata describes actual pictured elements and never invents a named person’s service or history.

ownerTypographyRequest.review: Actually read the final raster wording before approval; no misspellings or artificial variants count as extra designs.

verifiedContextNote.note: VA distinguishes Veterans Day appreciation of all who served, especially living veterans, from Memorial Day. It associates traditional U.S. poppy wearing with Memorial Day. Poppies in these illustrations are described only as visible decorative flowers; do not claim that poppy wearing is the standard U.S. Veterans Day custom or imply a funeral. Keep the collection centered on appreciation wording, flags and living community scenes.
